reviewerRole: Independent visual reviewer; no product code edits
reviewScope: Actual rendered images only; runtime gate failure investigated separately
observations: New broad red/grey blotches are clearly visible on the lower lip in both macro beauty and oblique beauty.
Colour-only views show those blotches persist without illumination; the variation is not evidence of more coherent surface structure.
Outline is visibly softer than R01, most notably around upper vermilion, but edge benefit has not been isolated in full shading.
Full-face beauty shows only a modest mouth difference; no substantial whole-person realism gain is established.

ablationInterpretation.meaning: Compositing alone affects output; this does not prove that compositing or boundary transition improves full material appearance.
ablationInterpretation.missingEvidence: No spatial-off beauty frame in this first artifact.

recommendedAction: Delete broad/local blotches and extra inner darkening.
Retain frozen original R01 material while independently testing corrected base-colour compositing.
Test only bounded outer-edge transition as a separate optional hypothesis; do not pre-approve it.
nextVisualGate: Same-condition R01 beauty, R02 edge-off beauty, and R02 edge-on beauty at macro, front and oblique views.
No new painted halo, shrunken vermilion, thick outline or lip colour covering readable texture.
If optional transition has no useful perceptual benefit, disable by default or delete it rather than retaining it because it was implemented.
limits: The observed first candidate is not the later reduced candidate.
A technical delta, local control response or source pass is not a visual quality pass.
